verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm WorkOS serves an llms.txt at https://workos.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and a markdown docs index at /docs.md. The docs pages themselves are served as .md URLs (e.g. /docs/sso.md, /docs/mcp.md), and an openapi.json is also reachable, giving agents machine-readable entry points. Missing for 10: the probe excerpts are truncated, so the llms.txt's completeness and structure aren't evidenced, and no first-party docs explain how agents should use these agent-oriented docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
